title: REPORT on the Gender Equality Strategy 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘or migration status’ and ‘gender identity’
part_context: Urges the Commission and the Member States to address intersectionality in all policies related to gender equality, acknowledging that GBV and discrimination are also compounded by factors such as age, race, ethnicity, minority <del>or migration status</del>, disability, gender identity and sexual orientation, and that the intersection of these factors creates multiple and unique forms of discrimination that require targeted, context-specific measures;
